BookCoverly – An Established Product Ecosystem

Two distinctive, profitable products included in this offer: BookCoverly Web App & BookCoverly Desktop.

  • * * * * * * * * * *

1. BookCoverly Web App

BookCoverly is a specialized web-based book cover design platform built for authors, self-publishers, designers, and publishing professionals. It brings professional book cover creation, publishing-specific design tools, creative assets, templates, stock imagery, and AI-assisted image generation together in one intuitive online environment.

Unlike general-purpose design platforms, BookCoverly is purpose-built for the unique requirements of book cover design and independent publishing. Users can create professional eBook covers, paperback covers, full print wraps, and other publishing graphics without having to navigate complicated professional design software or piece together multiple third-party resources.

A Complete Online Design Studio

BookCoverly provides users with the tools needed to take a book cover from concept to finished design within a single platform, either authentically or with the help of AI.

The web app includes:

  • Professional book cover design tools

  • eBook and print cover creation

  • Custom book sizing and layout

  • Automatic spine-width calculations

  • Bleed, trim, and safety guides

  • KDP and IngramSpark-ready workflows

  • Professional typography and text tools

  • Image importing and manipulation

  • Drawing and design tools

  • Color controls and professional layout features

  • Dozens of editable premade book cover templates

  • Millions of stock images

  • Royalty-free creative assets

  • Characters, backgrounds, frames, illustrations and mockups

  • Procreate-compatible creative resources

  • AI-assisted image generation

  • Multiple artistic styles and creative options

Designed for Authors

For independent authors, professional cover design can be expensive, technically challenging, and time-consuming. BookCoverly gives authors access to a specialized design environment that allows them to create polished, publishing-ready covers without needing to become professional graphic designers.

Designed for Designers

At the same time, experienced designers can use BookCoverly as a specialized production tool, combining their own artwork and creative direction with professional templates, stock imagery, and a large library of design assets.

This creates a platform that can serve a broad customer base across the self-publishing, indie publishing, graphic design, and creative services markets.

Built for Scalability

Because BookCoverly is delivered through the web, the platform has the potential to reach users globally without requiring traditional software installation or distribution.

Its web-based architecture also creates opportunities for multiple revenue models, including:

  • Subscription plans

  • Time-based access passes

  • Premium creative libraries

The platform can continue expanding beyond book cover creation into additional tools and services supporting the broader publishing workflow.

A Specialized Alternative to General Design Platforms

BookCoverly occupies a distinct position between complex professional design software and simplified general-purpose design platforms.

Its competitive advantage is specialization.

Rather than attempting to serve every type of graphic design user, BookCoverly is designed around the specific needs of book creators and publishing professionals—from genre-specific cover design to print specifications, spine calculations, publishing dimensions, creative assets, and book-focused templates.

A Major Differentiator: Copyright-Free Native Artwork

One of BookCoverly's strongest competitive advantages is its native image and artwork library.

BookCoverly provides a curated collection of copyright-free artwork created specifically for use within the platform, giving authors and designers a creative resource they can use with greater confidence when developing book covers.

This addresses a significant concern for today's authors and designers: where did the artwork come from, and do I have the right to use it?

The increasing scrutiny surrounding the use, licensing, and provenance of images on large, general-purpose creative platforms has made image rights an important consideration for professional book creators. BookCoverly takes a different approach by incorporating its own curated, copyright-free creative assets directly into the design environment.

Users can access artwork, illustrations, backgrounds, characters, frames, decorative elements, and other design resources without having to search across the internet and independently determine whether an image is appropriate for commercial book-cover use.

The result is a more controlled creative ecosystem designed specifically for the publishing market.

BookCoverly also provides access to millions of stock images, giving users an even broader range of visual options while maintaining the flexibility to incorporate their own photography, artwork, and other licensed resources.

Optional AI-Powered Creative Generation

BookCoverly also gives users the option to incorporate AI-assisted image generation directly into their creative workflow.

For users who want to explore ideas beyond the platform’s native artwork and stock-image libraries, BookCoverly’s AI tools can transform a written concept into high-resolution original artwork and visual concepts designed to help bring a book cover or creative project to life.

Users can describe the imagery they envision, experiment with different concepts and artistic directions, and generate visual options directly within the BookCoverly environment. This allows authors and designers to move from idea → concept → artwork → finished cover without leaving the platform.

The AI functionality is intentionally presented as an optional creative pathway. Users who prefer traditional design can work exclusively with BookCoverly’s native copyright-free artwork, templates, stock imagery, and their own creative assets. Those who want to explore AI-generated concepts have the flexibility to do so within the same design studio.

This creates a unique choice-driven creative ecosystem:

Native Copyright-Free Artwork → Stock Images → User-Created Artwork → AI-Generated Concepts & High-Resolution Art

By combining these options in one specialized platform, BookCoverly gives users greater creative freedom while allowing them to choose the workflow that best fits their project, design philosophy, and publishing needs.

This focused approach creates an opportunity to build a recognizable technology brand within a large and expanding independent publishing ecosystem.

  • * * * * * * * * * *

2. BookCoverly Desktop (https://bookcoverly.com/bookcoverly-legacy/)

The Established Book Cover Design Software Behind the BookCoverly Platform

BookCoverly Desktop is the original professional book cover design software that established the foundation for the BookCoverly product ecosystem.

Launched in 2017 (updated March 2026) and developed specifically for authors, independent publishers, and professional book cover designers, the desktop application provides specialized tools for creating both digital and print-ready book covers.

Unlike general-purpose graphic design software, BookCoverly Desktop was built around the unique technical requirements of book publishing. Users can create eBook covers, paperback covers, and full print wraps while working with precise publishing dimensions, automated spine calculations, bleed and trim guides, professional color settings, and other book-specific production tools.

Purpose-Built for Book Publishing

The software was designed to make professional book cover production more accessible without requiring users to master complex, general-purpose design programs.

Core capabilities include:

  • eBook and print cover creation

  • Full paperback and hardback wrap design

  • Automatic spine-width calculations

  • Custom book dimensions

  • Bleed, trim, and safety guides

  • CMYK and RGB color support

  • Adjustable layout guides

  • Image importing and manipulation

  • Professional typography and text tools

  • Color controls and design tools

  • Free-form drawing capabilities

  • Integrated creative assets and image resources

  • Publishing-ready cover workflows

  • 100+ editable, premade book cover templates

  • Complete project confidentiality

  • Work offline

Built for Scalability

As a web-based platform, BookCoverly can be delivered globally without traditional software installation or physical distribution. The model also creates opportunities for multiple revenue streams, including:

  • Premium asset libraries

  • Template memberships

  • Commercial licensing

  • Professional and business accounts

  • Reseller programs

  • White-label opportunities

  • Strategic partnerships

The platform can also expand into additional publishing-related tools and services, creating opportunities to increase customer lifetime value and build a broader creative ecosystem.

An Established Product With a Proven Foundation

BookCoverly Desktop represents years of development focused specifically on the book publishing market. Its specialized functionality, design workflows, creative resources, and established customer base provide a valuable foundation for the continued development of the BookCoverly brand.

Rather than beginning with a new concept, the BookCoverly ecosystem has an established history in book cover design software and independent publishing.

The desktop product demonstrates the underlying market need for specialized book-cover creation tools while providing an existing technology and brand foundation from which the newer web platform can evolve.

The BookCoverly Ecosystem

The BookCoverly Desktop application and the BookCoverly Web App represent two stages of the same product vision.

BookCoverly Desktop established the specialized book-cover design workflow.

BookCoverly Web expands that concept into a modern, accessible online platform with a broader creative flow, including native copyright-free artwork, millions of stock images, professional templates, digital assets, and optional AI-assisted image generation.

Together, they create a progression from established desktop software to a scalable web-based creative platform.

For a potential investor or acquirer, the desktop product provides additional value through its existing technology, specialized functionality, brand history, design expertise, and accumulated development experience within the book publishing industry.

A Specialized Technology Asset

BookCoverly Desktop is more than a standalone design application. It represents a body of specialized knowledge and technology developed around the specific needs of book creators.

Its functionality and product history can support the continued evolution of BookCoverly into a broader publishing technology company, while the established desktop application can continue to serve existing users and markets alongside the next-generation web platform.

Proven Marketing Responsiveness

BookCoverly has demonstrated that it responds strongly to consistent marketing efforts, particularly through paid advertising and email marketing. When campaigns are run consistently, we see measurable engagement and customer response, demonstrating that the audience is receptive to the product and that BookCoverly has proven marketing channels that can be scaled.

This is an important distinction which proves this is an established product with a demonstrated ability to generate customer interest and sales when marketing is consistently activated.

The existing email list provides a valuable owned audience, while paid advertising offers an additional avenue for reaching new authors and expanding the customer base. Together, these channels create a foundation for future growth without requiring the business to discover an entirely new market or customer profile.

With dedicated, consistent marketing, BookCoverly has significant opportunity to increase customer acquisition, recurring revenue, and overall lifetime customer value.

BookCoverly Desktop is the proven foundation. BookCoverly Web is the opportunity to scale that foundation.

Production-ready iOS AI app with no external model costs

Meta Prompt Lab is a live native iOS productivity app that turns rough ideas into structured, destination-ready prompts for ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.

Its specialist multi-stage workflow runs using Apple’s on-device Foundation Models on compatible devices. This means the app’s core AI functionality requires no external AI API account, server infrastructure or per-generation model costs.

The product is already live, monetised and actively developed. It is best suited to an iOS portfolio owner, indie developer, AI productivity company or SEO/content software operator with the distribution experience to grow it.

Current traction

Approximately 240 first-time downloads

Approximately 50,000 App Store impressions

11 in-app purchases

$78 lifetime proceeds

Approximately $5 current monthly recurring revenue

+173% download growth in the latest measured period

App Store screenshot experiment showed a +44% relative conversion improvement for the winning product-page treatment

All figures can be supported with redacted App Store Connect evidence or verified during a screen-share.⁠⁠​

What makes the app different

Native Swift and SwiftUI codebase

20-agent Pro prompt pipeline

Eight-agent free experience

Built around Apple’s on-device Foundation Models

No external AI API or server expenses for the core workflow

Structured exports for ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini

Prompt-quality scoring and targeted repair

50-case prompt evaluation harness

Contextual paywalls based on user intent

StoreKit 2 subscriptions and in-app purchases

Local conversion-funnel diagnostics

Prompt history and reusable workflows

Live Activities and Dynamic Island progress

Retention features, presets and streak mechanics

SEO Blog Generator included

The app also contains an on-device SEO Blog Generator, providing a second monetisation opportunity.

Its workflow includes:

Topic and audience input

Research synthesis

Editorial brief creation

Section-by-section drafting

Coherence editing

Style humanisation

Claim and SEO auditing

Internal-link opportunities

Metadata and keyword generation

Schema-markup generation

Markdown and HTML export

This gives the buyer both an AI prompt product and a content-generation feature capable of being positioned as an additional paid upgrade.

Included in the sale

Complete private Swift/SwiftUI source repository

Commit history and current production code

Transfer of the live App Store application

StoreKit 2 monetisation implementation

App-specific brand and design assets

App Store screenshots and localised metadata

ASO strategy and product-page testing material

Contextual paywall system

SEO Blog Generator implementation

Test and evaluation harnesses

Product roadmap and technical documentation

Two weeks of reasonable email handover support

The sale does not include the seller’s complete Apple Developer account, personal credentials, unrelated repositories or unrelated business systems.

Growth opportunities

A buyer could increase revenue by:

Applying and iterating on the winning App Store screenshot treatment.

Promoting the SEO Blog Generator as a separate paid feature.

Improving onboarding and first-session activation.

Testing annual and lifetime pricing.

Creating custom product pages for prompting, SEO and privacy audiences.

Expanding ASO localisation and keyword coverage.

Running Apple Ads against high-intent productivity searches.

Using the existing conversion diagnostics to improve the paywall funnel.

Adding complementary on-device AI workflows.

Cross-promoting the app through an existing iOS portfolio.

STAG (stagrack.com) is an established direct-to-consumer outdoor brand built on a genuinely differentiated product: a roof rack that mounts to virtually any vehicle using industrial vacuum technology. No bolts, no crossbars, no roof damage, installed in under two minutes and rated to 1,600+ lbs of certified pull strength. One universal base unit accepts interchangeable ski, bike, and surf attachments.

TRACK RECORD

From 2021 to 2026 the business generated $165,973 in sales across 540 orders at a $367 average order value and an 18.6% returning-customer rate, almost entirely through an automated Shopify store. Bundles carry roughly 75% gross margins. The brand shipped to 8 countries and sold out of ski racks every ski season, capped by inventory, not demand.

CURRENT STATUS (FULL TRANSPARENCY)

The store is currently dormant. The owner has shifted focus to other ventures and sales have wound down to roughly $500 over the trailing twelve months. STAG is sold as a proven brand and complete asset package, not a business at peak. You acquire demonstrated demand, full IP, a working supply chain, and inventory, then relaunch from a running start.

WHAT IS INCLUDED

The STAG brand, the stagrack.com domain, and all brand identity (used in commerce as a common-law mark, no federal registration on file). Two sales channels: a fully automated Shopify store and an Amazon storefront. Complete engineering IP, including technical CAD drawings for every component and the hinge system. Roughly 169 finished racks of inventory (about $84K retail, $20K at cost) plus base-unit spare parts, held with no storage fees. The full supplier network and warm introductions. A creative library of studio renders, lifestyle photography, and ready-to-run video ads. Audience and data: Instagram (@stagrack, about 2,369 followers), Facebook, YouTube, and the customer and email list. Written SOPs and a retainable low-cost marketing and developer contractor.

GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES

Restock the ski season, which sold out every year. Activate the Amazon storefront, which is set up but essentially unused. Expand paid channels beyond Facebook and Instagram. Pursue wholesale, with inbound retail interest historically and an order form already built. Extend the product range, since the vacuum base platform can support new attachments such as kayak and cargo.

WHY I AM SELLING

The owner has moved on to other ventures and does not have the bandwidth to actively operate STAG. It deserves an owner who will relaunch it.

PROCESS

Full financials, the supplier directory, the inventory schedule, and corporate and IP documents are available to qualified buyers under a simple NDA, followed by a walkthrough.

SearchThisImage is a 5-year-old image verification brand with a 32,000-follower Twitter audience, AI-assistant recommendations, and citations in journalism textbooks — recently relaunched as a meta reverse image search (Google + Yandex).

This isn't a typical SaaS sale. You're acquiring three assets in one bundle: a proven brand and audience built over 5 years, plus a freshly-shipped product capability ready for monetization.

What's Proven (5 Years of Compounding Value)

The Brand

Originally launched in 2021 as a Twitter bot featured on Product Hunt, SearchThisImage has been organically growing its presence for 5 years. The X API pricing changes in 2023 retired the bot, but the brand kept growing through word-of-mouth among journalists, fact-checkers, and OSINT researchers.

Press / fact-checker citations (permanent, indexed):

  • The Journalist's Toolbox — book by Mike Reilley, sold on Amazon

  • Dubawa — leading West African fact-checking platform

  • TechJury — reverse image search guide

The product is referenced unprompted by major AI assistants — verified with screenshots:

  • Grok (inside Twitter, where it carries the most weight)

  • Perplexity

  • ChatGPT (a daily traffic source)

The Audience — @SearchThisImage (32,000+ Followers)

The Twitter account is the crown jewel of this acquisition:

  • 32,000+ engaged, niche-relevant followers (fact-checkers, journalists, OSINT)

  • Drives 55% of all site traffic with an 80% engagement rate (last 90 days, GA-verified)

  • \"@searchthisimage\" is itself a branded Google search query (20 GSC clicks last quarter)

  • 100% organic growth — zero paid acquisition spend, ever

  • Steady, predictable signup velocity of ~10-20 new signups per day that has held consistent for months — including before, during, and after a recent Product Hunt launch

The User Base

The current search-site model launched in March 2026 (the original 2021 product was a Twitter bot, not a signup-based site). Since the relaunch:

  • 900+ organic user signups in ~3 months

  • Average ~10-20 new signups per day from a cold start, with $0 marketing spend

  • Pattern is steady — including before, during, and after a recent Product Hunt launch in June 2026

  • Global audience — India, Japan, China, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taiwan, US, EU

  • Acquisition is 100% organic, driven by the existing Twitter audience, AI assistant recommendations, and word-of-mouth

This is a baseline a buyer can underwrite from day one.

What's New (Recently Shipped — Upside for the Buyer)

This month, SearchThisImage relaunched with a major product upgrade:

Meta reverse image search. The site now runs Google Lens and Yandex in parallel, merging results via perceptual-hash deduplication. The two engines have almost no overlap — Google is strong on products and similar images; Yandex finds people, places, and source pages Google literally cannot see. Single-engine reverse image search misses things constantly.

Subscription tiers ($5 Plus, $19 Pro) and a developer API tier went live alongside the meta-search launch.

Important honesty: the meta-search and subscription tiers are new (live since May 2026). There are no paid conversions yet — the 911 signups predate the subscription model. This is upside the buyer captures: a brand and audience that's been organically growing for 5 years, paired with a monetization product that hasn't been tested yet.

Current Metrics (June 2026)

  • 900+ signups since the search-site launched in March 2026 (~3 months)

  • ~10-15 new signups per day, steady organic baseline

  • 1,495 active users / 1,627 sessions per month (GA-verified)

  • 59% overall engagement rate (80% on Twitter-sourced traffic)

  • Top traffic sources: Twitter (55%), direct (34%), ChatGPT.com (6%), Google (3%)

  • Revenue: $100 legacy ad revenue last year from the previous static-site era; $0 subscription revenue (tiers just launched)

What's Included in the Sale

  • Domain: searchthisimage.com

  • Full source code (frontend, backend, meta-search engine, API, dashboard)

  • @searchthisimage Twitter account (32K+ followers; full credential handover at closing)

  • Subscriber email list (912+ users, niche-targeted, organic)

  • Brand assets, logo, marketing copy, OG images

  • Press / citation kit (Grok/Perplexity/ChatGPT screenshots, book reference, fact-checker citations)

  • Documentation for the API and Yandex scraping infrastructure

  • 30 days of post-sale transition support included; deeper engagement available at $200/hr

Growth Opportunities for a New Owner

The biggest unlock is sitting in plain sight: 900+ free signups, zero paid conversions. A focused 30-day push on conversion (in-product upgrade prompts, lifecycle emails, a \"5 lifetime free meta-searches\" hard cap) should produce the first meaningful MRR within weeks.

Other paths a buyer could pursue:

  1. B2B outbound — OSINT firms, brand monitoring agencies, dating-app trust & safety teams pay $99-299/mo for tools like this. Two enterprise wins = $500+ MRR.

  2. Vertical wedge: dating-fraud verification — repackage meta-search as \"verify your match.\" Social Catfish charges $30+/mo on materially inferior tech.

  3. Add TinEye as a third engine ($200 entry barrier; positions as the most comprehensive meta-search available — defensible moat).

  4. Re-launch the Twitter bot on X's $200/mo paid API tier. The original growth engine is restartable.

  5. Deepen the AI-recommendation moat — targeted SEO/content work could increase Grok/Perplexity/ChatGPT recommendation frequency.

Why I'm Selling

I built SearchThisImage as a passion project in 2021, returned to it in 2026 with meta-search, and have brought it as far as a solo builder reasonably can. The brand and audience have outgrown the time I can give them, and the next chapter — converting the 900+ signups, doing B2B outbound, or pursuing a verticalization — requires dedicated full-time work that I'm not positioned to give it. The asset deserves an operator who can run it as their primary focus.

Why This Is Mispriced

Most acquisitions get you a product or an audience. This one delivers both:

  • 5 years of organically-built brand recognition that can't be bought or replicated quickly

  • A 32K-follower niche Twitter account valued at $16-64k by standard multiples ($0.50-$2.00/follower)

  • AI-assistant recommendation positioning that no competitor has

  • A freshly-shipped meta-search product with monetization tiers ready

The Twitter account alone, at standard niche-engagement multiples, exceeds the asking price.

For a buyer who can turn even 2-3% of the 900+ signups into paid users at $5-19/mo, the MRR pays back a significant portion of the acquisition cost within months — and the organic signup baseline keeps adding ~360 new users every month at zero cost.

The Audience — @SearchThisImage (32,000+ Followers)

The Twitter account is the crown jewel of this acquisition:

  • 32,000+ engaged, niche-relevant followers (fact-checkers, journalists, OSINT)

  • Drives 55% of all site traffic with an 80% engagement rate (last 90 days, GA-verified)

  • \"@searchthisimage\" is itself a branded Google search query (20 GSC clicks last quarter)

  • 100% organic growth — zero paid acquisition spend, ever

  • Steady, predictable signup velocity of ~10-20 new signups per day that has held consistent for months — including before, during, and after a recent Product Hunt launch

The User Base

The current search-site model launched in March 2026 (the original 2021 product was a Twitter bot, not a signup-based site). Since the relaunch:

  • 900+ organic user signups in ~3 months

  • Average ~10-20 new signups per day from a cold start, with $0 marketing spend

  • Pattern is steady — including before, during, and after a recent Product Hunt launch in June 2026

  • Global audience — India, Japan, China, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taiwan, US, EU

  • Acquisition is 100% organic, driven by the existing Twitter audience, AI assistant recommendations, and word-of-mouth

This is a baseline a buyer can underwrite from day one.

What's New (Recently Shipped — Upside for the Buyer)

This month, SearchThisImage relaunched with a major product upgrade:

Meta reverse image search. The site now runs Google Lens and Yandex in parallel, merging results via perceptual-hash deduplication. The two engines have almost no overlap — Google is strong on products and similar images; Yandex finds people, places, and source pages Google literally cannot see. Single-engine reverse image search misses things constantly.

Subscription tiers ($5 Plus, $19 Pro) and a developer API tier went live alongside the meta-search launch.

Important honesty: the meta-search and subscription tiers are new (live since May 2026). There are no paid conversions yet — the 911 signups predate the subscription model. This is upside the buyer captures: a brand and audience that's been organically growing for 5 years, paired with a monetization product that hasn't been tested yet.

Current Metrics (June 2026)

  • 900+ signups since the search-site launched in March 2026 (~3 months)

  • ~10-15 new signups per day, steady organic baseline

  • 1,495 active users / 1,627 sessions per month (GA-verified)

  • 59% overall engagement rate (80% on Twitter-sourced traffic)

  • Top traffic sources: Twitter (55%), direct (34%), ChatGPT.com (6%), Google (3%)

  • Revenue: $100 legacy ad revenue last year from the previous static-site era; $0 subscription revenue (tiers just launched)

What's Included in the Sale

  • Domain: searchthisimage.com

  • Full source code (frontend, backend, meta-search engine, API, dashboard)

  • @searchthisimage Twitter account (32K+ followers; full credential handover at closing)

  • Subscriber email list (912+ users, niche-targeted, organic)

  • Brand assets, logo, marketing copy, OG images

  • Press / citation kit (Grok/Perplexity/ChatGPT screenshots, book reference, fact-checker citations)

  • Documentation for the API and Yandex scraping infrastructure

  • 30 days of post-sale transition support included; deeper engagement available at $200/hr

Growth Opportunities for a New Owner

The biggest unlock is sitting in plain sight: 900+ free signups, zero paid conversions. A focused 30-day push on conversion (in-product upgrade prompts, lifecycle emails, a \"5 lifetime free meta-searches\" hard cap) should produce the first meaningful MRR within weeks.

Other paths a buyer could pursue:

  1. B2B outbound — OSINT firms, brand monitoring agencies, dating-app trust & safety teams pay $99-299/mo for tools like this. Two enterprise wins = $500+ MRR.

  2. Vertical wedge: dating-fraud verification — repackage meta-search as \"verify your match.\" Social Catfish charges $30+/mo on materially inferior tech.

  3. Add TinEye as a third engine ($200 entry barrier; positions as the most comprehensive meta-search available — defensible moat).

  4. Re-launch the Twitter bot on X's $200/mo paid API tier. The original growth engine is restartable.

  5. Deepen the AI-recommendation moat — targeted SEO/content work could increase Grok/Perplexity/ChatGPT recommendation frequency.

Why I'm Selling

I built SearchThisImage as a passion project in 2021, returned to it in 2026 with meta-search, and have brought it as far as a solo builder reasonably can. The brand and audience have outgrown the time I can give them, and the next chapter — converting the 900+ signups, doing B2B outbound, or pursuing a verticalization — requires dedicated full-time work that I'm not positioned to give it. The asset deserves an operator who can run it as their primary focus.

Why This Is Mispriced

Most acquisitions get you a product or an audience. This one delivers both:

  • 5 years of organically-built brand recognition that can't be bought or replicated quickly

  • A 32K-follower niche Twitter account valued at $16-64k by standard multiples ($0.50-$2.00/follower)

  • AI-assistant recommendation positioning that no competitor has

  • A freshly-shipped meta-search product with monetization tiers ready

The Twitter account alone, at standard niche-engagement multiples, exceeds the asking price.

For a buyer who can turn even 2-3% of the 900+ signups into paid users at $5-19/mo, the MRR pays back a significant portion of the acquisition cost within months — and the organic signup baseline keeps adding ~360 new users every month at zero cost.

Regalo Musicale is a validated AI-powered personalized song gifting project.

Customers complete a 7-step form with details about the recipient, occasion, relationship, memories, desired emotion, language and musical inspiration. Instead of choosing a generic music genre, users select a reference artist and, optionally, a specific song by that artist. This reference is used to guide the final song’s style, mood and genre direction. The system then creates a fully personalized song and sends it by email in about 15 minutes.

The project was launched as a paid validation test and generated €521 gross revenue from 35 paid orders in 2 months, at an average order value of €14.89. Paid ads generated the first traction with €423 in ad spend, resulting in approximately 1.23x gross ROAS during the validation phase.

Direct costs are low. Each song costs around €0.50 to generate, Stripe fees are roughly €0.47 per order, and monthly hosting costs are low. Estimated margin before ads is around 88–90% including hosting.

The project is already prepared for international expansion. The WordPress website includes GTranslate, and the website copy has been adapted to produce clean translations at least in English. Users can generate songs in any language they choose, making the product suitable for non-Italian markets.

Included in the sale:

  • - Working Go backend for automated song creation and email delivery

  • - Lightweight architecture designed for concurrent request processing

  • - Setup guide and code documentation

  • - Domain and website assets for regalomusicale.it

  • - WordPress website configured with GTranslate

  • - 5 SEO/GEO/AEO-optimized blog articles

  • - Social media accounts

  • - Private GPTs/prompts for SEO content, customer interview analysis, ad ideas and brand-consistent image generation

  • - 3 customer interview transcripts and analyses

  • - Customer interview guide

  • - Survey data and analysis from 110 respondents

  • - Ready-made advertising assets

  • - Stripe revenue proof

  • - 14 days of post-sale support

Tech stack:

  • - Backend: Go

  • - Website: WordPress

  • - APIs/services: OpenAI, Resend, SunoAPI, Stripe

  • - Text generation: GPT-5.1

  • - Song generation: Suno v5

Growth opportunities:

  • - Relaunch paid ads with improved creatives and better tracking

  • - Increase pricing from €14.90 to tiered packages

  • - Add upsells such as AI-Generated video, printed QR code gift card or multiple song versions (style or language)

  • - Create seasonal campaigns for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, Valentine’s Day, Christmas, Mother’s Day and Father’s Day

  • - Expand internationally, starting with English-speaking markets

  • - Create dedicated landing pages for different countries and languages

  • - Partner with wedding planners, gift shops, creators and event agencies

  • - Build an affiliate/referral system

  • - Turn the backend into a white-label personalized song engine

Important note: customer emails and personal data are not included. Aggregated and anonymized customer insights, survey analysis and interview learnings are included.

TITLE / HEADLINE

Aura — AI that judges your daily decisions. Live iOS app, real brand, built-in viral loop. Pre-revenue by design, builder wanted.

Preview

I built Aura solo: you log something you did, an AI roasts it and scores you from -10,000 to +10,000, and you climb a leaderboard against friends. It's live on the App Store with a growing organic audience, a content engine, a mascot brand, and a creator program — all running on effectively $0 in paid acquisition.

The honest pitch: the hard part is done. The product works, the loop is fun, the brand is sharp, and there's a built-in viral mechanic (shareable verdict cards). What it needs now is someone who can grind on it full-time. I can't right now, and it deserves that.

Looking for a builder, not a flipper. Open to a structure where I take modest cash and keep a small (~10%) stake — I want to stay lightly involved and watch it run, not squeeze every dollar out.

STARTUP DESCRIPTION

Aura is an AI-powered social app where users log a daily decision — something they did, good, bad, or questionable — and an AI instantly judges it, returning a verdict and a score from -10,000 to +10,000. Users track their total aura over time, compete with friends on a leaderboard, and share verdict cards to social media.

The app was built solo from idea to App Store launch in roughly six weeks, using AI-assisted development to compress the build. It launched on the iOS App Store and has grown to 128 users and 3,100 Instagram followers through organic content and a creator partnership program — with no paid acquisition to date.

The core insight: Gen Z already narrates and scores their daily lives online (\"aura points\" is an existing cultural meme). Aura turns that behavior into an interactive, social, gamified loop with a built-in viral mechanic (shareable verdict cards).

KEY HIGHLIGHTS

  • Users: 128 registered; 128 first-time App Store downloads + 12 redownloads (90-day)

  • App Store conversion rate: 7.37% (impression → download, 90-day daily average) — strong for the category

  • Impressions: 2.51K / Product page views: 589 (90-day)

  • Instagram: 3,100 followers

  • Annual revenue: $0 — pre-revenue by design; monetization deliberately deferred to prioritize growth. Runway fully un-tapped and available to buyer.

  • Annual profit: N/A (pre-revenue). Operating costs minimal — see Financials.

  • Monthly operating cost: approx: ~$1,000 marketing contractors (Upwork, flexible/at-will) + infra: Supabase ~$15, Claude API capped ~$10, EAS builds ~$1-2/build, domain]. Note: the ~$1,000 contractor spend is fully discretionary and can be cut at will by the buyer.

  • Churn / LTV / CAC: not yet meaningfully measurable at current scale + pre-revenue. Early PostHog retention data available to serious buyers under NDA.

  • Viral mechanic: shareable verdict cards drive organic distribution at ~$0 CAC.

TEAM

Solo-built and solo-operated. The founder handles all technical development, product, and strategy.

Marketing and content are handled by a small team of contractors sourced through Upwork, costing approximately $1,000/month combined:

  • Founder — full product, engineering, and strategy ownership

  • Social media manager (contractor) — daily Instagram/TikTok posting, community engagement, and the ManyChat creator funnel

  • ASO/marketing specialist (contractor) — App Store Optimization, keyword and metadata work

  • Play Store listing contractor (contractor) — Android store assets and listing copy

These are flexible, project-based contractor relationships with no long-term commitment. A buyer can retain, replace, or wind them down at will — none transfer as fixed obligations. No full-time payroll transfers with the sale. The app is structured to be run by a single technical operator or a small team.

TECH STACK

  • Frontend: React Native via Expo — one codebase, iOS + Android

  • Build pipeline: EAS Build

  • Backend: Supabase — PostgreSQL, auth, storage, edge functions, row-level security

  • AI: Anthropic Claude API — verdict generation, daily prompts, image/text moderation

  • Push: Expo Push Service → APNs

  • Analytics: PostHog, Firebase Analytics

  • Ad measurement: Meta SDK integration in progress

  • Web/legal: GitHub Pages (Terms, Privacy, marketing site at aura-judge.com)

Lean, low-cost, no servers to manage, pay-as-you-go AI.

MARKETING & GROWTH

Fully organic to date, no paid acquisition:

  • Content engine — TikTok/Instagram short-form video, faceless formats, branded mascot character

  • Creator program — $15-per-post creator funnel via ManyChat driving UGC and installs

  • Share cards — every verdict generates a shareable image; built-in organic loop

  • Reddit — dedicated subreddit and organic presence

  • ASO — ongoing App Store Optimization

Results to date (App Store Connect, trailing 90 days):

  • 128 first-time downloads + 12 redownloads

  • 2,510 impressions, 589 product page views

  • 7.37% conversion rate (impression → download, daily average) — strong for the App Store, indicating the listing and creative convert well

  • 228 app updates shipped — reflects active, high-frequency iteration

Retention is early and still developing. App Store Connect's opt-in-only sample shows roughly ~3.5% Day 1 and ~2% Day 7, tapering after — a partial dataset, not the full user base. This is the clearest area of opportunity: the acquisition and conversion funnel works (7.37% conversion is healthy), so the primary lever for a full-time operator is deepening retention through the already-built leaderboard, streak, and social mechanics. Fuller retention data from PostHog is available to serious buyers under NDA.

REVENUE & PROFIT

Pre-revenue by design. Monetization deferred to protect early growth/retention signals.

  • ARR / MRR: $0

  • Operating costs: — approx ~$1,000/month marketing contractors (Upwork, at-will) + minimal infra (Supabase ~$15, Claude API capped ~$10, builds, domain). The contractor spend is discretionary and can be reduced or cut entirely by the buyer with no penalty.

  • Monetization runway (designed, un-built, available to buyer):

    • Subscription tier \"aura+\" — planned $2.99/mo, cosmetic + identity perks

    • In-feed ads (AdMob) — sequenced for post-scale

  • Buyer inherits a clean, un-monetized base and a designed monetization path — the revenue upside has not been used up.

RETURN ON INVESTMENT

Pre-revenue, so ROI is a function of activating the monetization runway + existing growth engine, not current cash flow.

Payback depends on:

  • Activating the designed subscription tier against the growing user base

  • Continuing the organic content engine (already producing installs at ~$0 CAC)

  • Scaling paid acquisition once retention is proven

Optional model —

ASSETS INCLUDED IN SALE

  • iOS app — live on App Store, listing + App Store ID included

  • Full source code — React Native/Expo, backend edge functions, moderation + judging pipeline

  • Supabase backend — database, auth, storage, RLS

  • User base — 128 registered users with activity history

  • Instagram — 3100 followers

  • Reddit community — dedicated subreddit

  • Brand assets — logo, mascot, design system (colors/fonts), Canva template library

  • Content library — video series, carousels, captions, creator program assets

  • Domain — aura-judge.com with site, Terms, Privacy

  • Creator program — ManyChat funnel + onboarding flow

  • Analytics — PostHog + Firebase history

  • DMCA agent registration — US Copyright Office

  • Android build — prepared/in-progress for Play Store

RISKS

  • Early stage / small user base. Mitigation: content + creator engine already producing organic installs at ~$0 CAC; product loop built and working.

  • Pre-revenue. Mitigation: also the upside — monetization path designed but un-built, so revenue opportunity is fully intact.

  • Retention unproven at scale. Mitigation: early PostHog data under NDA; leaderboard + social mechanics designed for retention.

  • Platform dependency (Claude API, Apple/Google). Mitigation: costs low + capped; AI layer modular and swappable.

  • Solo-built. Mitigation: clean codebase, documentation, and a transition/handoff period can be included.

SUMMARY — WHY BUY AURA

Aura is a working, launched product in a culturally-relevant niche (Gen Z, AI, social gamification) with a genuinely lean cost structure and a monetization path that is fully intact and un-tapped.

A buyer acquires:

  • A live iOS app with a real (if early) user base and a growing social audience

  • A built-in viral mechanic (share cards) already producing organic, ~$0-CAC installs

  • A designed but un-built monetization runway — the revenue upside hasn't been spent

  • A complete brand, content engine, and creator program ready to scale

  • A clean, modern, low-cost stack one technical operator can run

Best suited to a builder who wants an early-stage but real product with cultural momentum and clear monetization levers — not a mature cash-flowing business. The hard part (a working product, brand, and growth engine) is done; the monetization upside the current owner deliberately left on the table is yours to capture.

DEAL TERMS

Asking: 3,000 Structure: open to modest cash + retained ~10% stake for a builder who wants to run it. Founder available for 90 days transition support.

I'll lead with the part most listings bury: this has no users and no revenue. Four briefs have ever been posted and I posted all four. Total money collected from strangers: zero. If you're looking for a business with a growth curve, close the tab.

What's for sale is three months of finished engineering and a domain.

What works, today, in production:

  • Post a brief → Stripe checkout (live mode, real money, real webhook) → brief goes live

  • Apply to a brief: screening answer, price, portfolio URL

  • Direct hire — commission a named expert, skipping the open pool

  • Experts directory with search, individual expert pages

  • In-platform messaging between client and expert

  • Client and expert dashboards, proposal detail, accept flow

  • Transactional email on new proposal / acceptance (Resend, verified domain)

  • Auth with full password reset, row-level security throughout

  • robots.txt, sitemap, Google Search Console verified

Stack: Next.js 16 (App Router) · Supabase (Postgres + Auth + RLS) · Stripe live mode · Resend · Vercel · TypeScript throughout.

What is NOT built, plainly:

  • No escrow. Project payment happens off-platform between the parties.

  • No commission collection. Only the posting fee is charged.

  • No ratings or reviews.

  • No dispute resolution beyond a Stripe chargeback on the posting fee.

So it's a paid-listing marketplace with a handshake, not a full transactional one. Escrow and commission are the same engineering problem (Stripe Connect), and they're the obvious next build.

Why I'm selling. I'm a developer, not a marketer. I built the product and then discovered I have no way to acquire clients — no audience, no network, no ad budget, and no appetite for cold outreach. That's not a product problem I can engineer my way out of. If you have distribution and no product, we're exact opposites and this is worth more to you than to me.

Costs to run: ~$35/yr (domain). Supabase, Vercel, and Resend all sit inside free tiers at this volume.

What transfers: the domain, the GitHub repo with full history, the database migrations, and a written handover. Deploy takes about an hour — new Supabase project, your own Stripe keys, done.

What doesn't: my Stripe account, and the existing user data — 5 accounts, 3 of them junk. You want a clean database anyway.

Honest note on the homepage. It currently reads as my personal storefront, because that's what I repurposed it into. The full marketplace homepage is one git revert away, and every marketplace route is still live and working. Nothing was removed.

Amity is a live iOS subscription app for families with more than one child. It does two main things: it remembers whose turn it is for the things kids fight over daily (front seat, tablet, who picks the show) so the standoffs stop — and it walks kids through a guided five-step process to resolve the bigger fights themselves. There’s also a prevention layer: a monthly “Peace Audit” that assesses the home conditions driving conflict rather than blaming the kids, a workshop for redesigning recurring fights, per-child connection tracking, and an insight loop that correlates daily signals against fight days. Plus an optional, off-by-default Scripture layer as a deliberate wedge into the homeschool/faith market.

Live on the US App Store since June 2026. 4 × 5-star reviews. ~15 installs, 5 trial starts, $0 revenue. This is a pre-revenue asset sale: you’re buying a finished product and a running start, not cash flow, and it’s priced accordingly. I’ll share App Store Connect and RevenueCat screenshots on request.

What’s included:

  • - Full source — 37 files, ~8,800 lines of TypeScript, clean and heavily commented

  • - The live App Store listing, transferred via Apple’s official flow (reviews and users intact)

  • - Supabase backend — 13 migrations, full row-level security, realtime multi-caregiver sync, offline queue

  • - ~149 rows of seeded content in editable content tables — every word in the app is database-driven, so a new owner can rewrite, expand or translate the entire content layer with no code and no App Store review

  • - RevenueCat subscriptions (7-day trial → monthly/annual), live and tested

  • - Domain amity-app.com + deployed landing page

  • - Codemagic CI — push a branch, get a signed build (no Mac required)

  • - Marketing library: ready-to-post social slideshow sets + a generator script, a 33-second demo video, App Store screenshot compositor, a 20-target press outreach list with replies logged, and 500 unused promo codes for reviewer seeding

  • Stack:

  • React / Next.js / TypeScript + Capacitor for iOS, Supabase, RevenueCat, PostHog (privacy-first: no autocapture, no session recording, no PII), Codemagic. One codebase — Android is a realistic near-term add, not a rewrite.

  • Why I’m selling:

  • I’m a homeschooling mom of five. I built Amity because my own house needed it and I loved building it — but the growth side isn’t my skill set or my temperament. Nothing is broken and nothing is hidden. It’s a finished product without a marketer.

  • What you’d need to bring:

  • Distribution — I’d rather say it plainly than have you find it in week two. I’ve also learned this category has thin App Store search demand (parents don’t search “sibling fight app”), so it wins on content, community and PR rather than search ads. I have the ad data and outreach logs to prove it, and they transfer with the sale.

  • Included in the handover: two weeks of email support — architecture walkthrough, build/deploy process, content-table editing, and all the growth research if requested.

Payments run through Apple In-App Purchase via RevenueCat, not Stripe. Revenue is $0 - happy to screenshot App Store Connect and the RevenueCat dashboard on request.

What you're buying

Three separate, working sites under one brand — plus the marketing machine that feeds them.

1. BPNETIX (bpnetix.com) — DNA kits, $499 each, ~$304 gross margin. Customer sends a saliva swab, gets a genetic report on how their body handles fat, carbs, and calories, then receives meal plans and macros built around those results.

2. FitFormula (fitformula.bpnetix.com) — $19.99/month recurring. The same AI coaching, meal planning, and macro tracking, minus the DNA test. Captures every customer who won't spend $499 up front. Includes training programs built by celebrity trainers and bodybuilders.

3. CoachFormula — white-label B2B. A separate deployable copy of the platform that a fitness coach or trainer runs under their own name and domain. The coach can upload their own meal plans, set macros manually, and review client logs — or leave the AI to do all of it. Sell it per coach, at recurring margin, to a market that has no scalable coaching product today.

Why this isn't another fitness app

Every fitness app hands the customer a tracker and walks away. The bottleneck in this industry has never been tracking — it's that a human coach can only carry so many clients, so coaching businesses cap out and hiring more kills the margin.

Here the AI coach runs the whole client relationship, 24/7. It reads the DNA results, builds the plan, sets the macros, adjusts when someone stalls, logs food from a photo or a barcode, and answers questions at 2am. It will build a meal on the spot around whatever the client is in the mood for and their remaining macros — so meal prep is optional and clients can eat out or wing it without falling off. Zero dietitians on payroll. Margin holds at 100 clients or 10,000, at roughly $7/month running cost.

That's exactly what makes CoachFormula sellable: a coach gets a full one-to-one coaching product without hiring a single coach.

The marketing engine comes with it

This is not a bare codebase. The customer acquisition system is built and documented:

  • A complete AI video ad production workflow — Seedance for footage, ElevenLabs for voiceover, CapCut for assembly — with tested prompts and scripts

  • A library of UGC-style ad creative and a macro-recipe video series designed as the main content engine

  • Automated daily/weekly AI content inside the apps: nutrition newsletter, fitness newsletter, and recipe of the day, with AI-generated photos

  • GHL automation fully integrated, including an SMS sales bot for lead nurturing

  • Meta Pixel installed, PostHog analytics mirrored across both consumer apps, dedicated ads landing funnel

A buyer isn't guessing how to acquire customers. The funnel is built — it needs ad spend pointed at it.

Status: pre-revenue

Not launched or marketed. No customers, no revenue. You're buying finished infrastructure, proven margin structure, and a ready acquisition system. The remaining work is traffic.

Included: full codebase and GitHub repo, Supabase projects, all three domains and deployments, branding and design assets, the complete ad creative library and video prompt system, GHL automation setup, and handover support.

FirstPitch is an AI platform that generates personalized B2B value propositions, go-to-market pitches, and Proof of Value cases — complete with ROI simulations — in under 60 seconds.

The problem we solve
B2B sales teams lose most of their time on the same task: translating a generic product story into a case that resonates with one specific prospect. Reps either send generic messaging that gets ignored, or spend hours per account researching and building a credible business case. Neither scales.

How it works
You provide the prospect (URL and account data). FirstPitch analyzes the target, then produces:

  • A personalized value proposition aligned to that company's specific context

  • A GTM pitch tailored to the account

  • A Proof of Value case with a deterministic ROI simulation backed by verifiable data sources

  • Ready-to-use sales collateral — argumentaire commercial, pitch decks, outbound messaging

The ROI figures are deterministic, not hallucinated — that's the credibility layer that makes the output usable in a real sales conversation.

Who it's for
B2B SaaS companies with sales teams of roughly 5–20 reps, primarily in tech. Buyers are VP Sales, CROs, Heads of Sales, and Sales Directors at companies of 11–500 employees.

Why it matters
Personalization at the account level is the single biggest driver of outbound reply rates, and it's the first thing teams drop when volume goes up. FirstPitch removes that trade-off: every prospect gets a bespoke business case, at the speed of a templated one.

Positioning
Sales enablement and AI prospecting — sitting between lead sourcing tools (Apollo, Hunter) and CRM/sequencing platforms. Bilingual (EN/FR), self-serve, live at firstpitch.co since 2024.

Ciphera is a production-ready, security-first API Credential Intelligence Platform and vault. Designed for modern developers and security-conscious enterprises, Ciphera separates credential values (secrets) from credential meaning (metadata). It features automated credential rotation driven by a sovereign Avalanche Subnet, zero-knowledge storage architecture, and an intelligent anomaly detection engine.

This acquisition offers a fully functional, production-hardened software asset with a premium brand, complete developer console, companion CLI tool, security documentation, and legal frameworks. It is ready for immediate commercial launch.

. Product Features & Moat

- Zero-Knowledge Architecture: Cryptographic encryption (AES-256-GCM) at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Raw credentials never leave the client's device unencrypted.

- Sovereign Subnet Engine: Decentralized credential rotation workflows run on an Avalanche Subnet, preventing single-point-of-failure database breaches.

- Credential Intelligence: Real-time monitoring and anomaly detection to identify leaked api keys and suspicious traffic patterns.

- Multi-Interface Access: Standardized REST APIs, a polished developer dashboard UI, and a terminal CLI tool (`cph`) for developers.

- Enterprise-Ready Onboarding: Interactive client key generation ceremonies, identity provider integration support, and detailed audit trails.


Technology Stack

- Core Cryptographic Library: TypeScript (decoupled, modular structure).

- Backend API: Node.js, Express, TypeScript, Sentry, Pino, Helmet, Rate Limiter, CSRF protection.

- Database & Auth: Supabase (PostgreSQL with RLS policy enforcement).

- Frontend Developer Dashboard: React 18, Vite, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion, Spline (Premium 3D graphics).

- CLI Tool: Node.js, Commander.js.

- DevOps: Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions (CI pipeline).

Cost Structure & Infrastructure Projections

Ciphera’s infrastructure was architected to minimize fixed overhead, keeping margins exceptionally high:

- Baseline Cost: ~$6.00 / month (Domain, Supabase Free Tier, Railway Hobby Tier).

- Scale Cost (up to 5,000 requests/day): ~$71.00 / month (Supabase Pro, Railway Developer, Vercel Pro).

- Scale Cost (up to 50,000 requests/day): ~$486.00 / month (Dedicated compute & Database scaling).


Ideal Buyer Profiles

- Developer Tool Aggregators: Companies looking to add API key management, rotation, and monitoring capabilities to their existing suite of SaaS products.

- Cybersecurity & DevSecOps Firms: Cybersecurity startups wanting to immediately deploy a zero-knowledge secret manager.

- Web3 Infrastructure Providers: Organizations looking to leverage sovereign subnet orchestration for decentralized credential workflows.

Growth Opportunities for Acquirer

1. Self-Serve Developer SaaS: Launch the freemium pricing plans (mapped in Stripe) to drive viral developer adoption.

2. Enterprise Licensing: Sell the Sovereign VPC self-hosted licensing tier (detailed in the licensing documentation) starting at $100k/year to enterprise customers.

3. Desktop & Mobile Apps: Compile and distribute the packaged desktop app using the existing Tauri integration config.

  • Recurring Memberships: Tiered monthly/annual subscriptions for clients (for lower fees and priority hiring) and freelancers (for premium job placement and lower commission rates).

Current Traction:

  • 100+ Vetted Tech Developers onboarded and ready to work.

  • 10 Active Clients already registered on the platform.

Why Acquire This? Building two-sided marketplace infrastructure—especially with hybrid credit and subscription billing logic—takes months of development time. This acquisition lets you bypass the entire build phase and skip the cold-start problem with an active initial user base. An incoming founder can immediately focus on marketing, converting client leads, and generating immediate cash flow.

Included in Sale:

  • Full source code repository and complete IP rights

  • Database schemas, active user records, and developer directory

Global importers and freight forwarders face systemic financial leakage due to ocean carrier billing inaccuracies. Carriers routinely charge Demurrage (port storage) and Detention (equipment usage) fees during periods when the cargo was completely inaccessible to the importer — during carrier-induced vessel rollovers, terminal gate lockouts, holiday port closures, and customs examinations.

Audit teams currently validate these charges manually. An operator cross-references a single carrier invoice row against up to four physical gate receipts (EIR slips) per container. A 20-container shipment requires matching 80 separate timestamps against multi-tiered, progressive tariff structures — roughly 45 minutes per invoice, with calculation errors and costly overpayments slipping through.

DD Auditor automates this entire workflow: AI-powered extraction of carrier invoices and gate receipts, an editable verification grid, a per-container math engine with progressive tariff tiers and automatic exception deductions (vessel rolls, gate lockouts, customs holds), and a carrier-ready dispute outbox that packages audit findings into dispute emails.

Production-ready React + Node.js + Python codebase with 25 test files, full CI/CD, PostgreSQL + Redis, Google Gemini-powered extraction, OAuth2 + multi-tenant RLS, and Dodo Payments billing — deployable out of the box.

SUMMARY

Skip 2–4 years of development by acquiring a production-ready native collaboration platform that's been live since 2022. The sale includes native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps, a Java backend, React admin and customer portals, WebRTC voice/video, real-time messaging, and AWS infrastructure. Designed for straightforward white-label customization, it's an ideal foundation for founders and software companies looking to launch or expand a collaboration product without starting from scratch.

HIGHLIGHTS

  • Native iOS (Swift) & Android (Kotlin)

  • Java Backend + React Web Portals

  • Live Since November 2022

  • Complete Source Code Included

  • White-Label Ready

  • Built-In Messaging & WebRTC Voice/Video

  • AWS Production Infrastructure

  • Estimated Replacement Cost: $300K–$500K+

 

OVERVIEW

 

Skip 2–4 years of engineering by acquiring a mature, production-tested collaboration platform that has been live on the Apple App Store and Google Play since November 2022.

The platform has already solved many of the complex engineering challenges involved in building a modern collaboration product, allowing the next owner to focus on branding, customers, and growth instead of core infrastructure.

 

This is NOT an MVP, prototype, or abandoned side project. It has been continuously refined through real-world use and includes the complete source code, production infrastructure, and supporting components needed to operate, customize, or rebrand under your own company.

 

Complete collaboration platform—not just mobile apps. The sale includes native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) applications, a Java backend, React customer and administrative portals, production cloud infrastructure, and the complete source code.

 

Every major system required to operate a modern collaboration platform—including messaging, voice and video, authentication, administration, monetization, and cloud infrastructure—is already built and production-tested.

 

This acquisition is ideal for founders, software companies, agencies, and product teams looking to launch or expand a collaboration product without spending years building core infrastructure from scratch.

 

PRODUCT VALIDATION

 

• Live on the Apple App Store and Google Play since November 2022

• 941 registered users

• 348 new users added during 2026

• 9 five-star App Store reviews

• Recent real-world user engagement demonstrates the platform remains active and production-tested.

 

Rather than existing only as source code, this platform has benefited from years of bug fixes, usability improvements, and production refinement that are difficult to reproduce in a newly built product.

 

WHAT'S INCLUDED

 

The sale includes:

•           Native Swift iOS application

•           Native Kotlin Android application

•           Java backend

•           React customer portal

•           React administrative portal

•           Complete source code for the iOS app, Android app, backend, and web portals

•           AWS deployment configuration

•           Amazon RDS MySQL database

•           Firebase integration

•           QuickBlox messaging

•           WebRTC voice and video infrastructure

•           Push notification infrastructure

•           Production database schema

•           Technical documentation

•           App Store and Google Play listing assets

•           Design assets

•           Reasonable technical transition assistance following the sale

 

INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

 

The sale includes ownership of all original source code developed for the platform, including the iOS application, Android application, Java backend, and React web applications.

 

The platform was developed specifically for this business. No outside developers retain ownership rights.

 

MAJOR FEATURES

 

The platform includes a comprehensive collaboration feature set, including:

•           Real-time group messaging

•           Direct messaging

•           Topic-based conversations

•           Native voice and video calling

•           Shared calendars

•           Event scheduling

•           RSVP management

•           Attendance tracking

•           Photo and file sharing

•           Push notifications

•           Administrative dashboard

•           Customer self-service portal

•           User management

•           Subscription and monetization infrastructure

 

WHITE-LABEL OPPORTUNITY

 

The platform was intentionally designed to support straightforward rebranding and customization.

 

Potential applications include:

•           Church and faith-based software

•           Volunteer management

•           Community organizations

•           HOA communities

•           Sports organizations

•           Schools and PTAs

•           Membership organizations

•           Workforce communication

•           Team collaboration

•           Industry-specific SaaS products

 

TECHNOLOGY

 

Built on a proven production technology stack including:

Swift, Kotlin, Java, React, AWS, Amazon RDS MySQL, Firebase, QuickBlox, WebRTC, Stripe, Apple In-App Purchases, Google Play Billing, and Google AdMob.

 

ENGINEERING REPLACEMENT VALUE

 

Rebuilding a comparable platform from scratch would typically require approximately 2–4 years of engineering effort and an estimated $300,000–$500,000+ investment before reaching a similar level of production maturity.

 

Instead of rebuilding foundational infrastructure, the next owner receives a mature platform that has already been operating in production since 2022, allowing them to focus immediately on customization, customer acquisition, commercialization, and growth.

 

IDEAL BUYER

 

This acquisition is an excellent fit for:

•           SaaS founders seeking an established technical foundation

•           Software companies expanding into collaboration software

•           Development agencies seeking a white-label platform

•           Entrepreneurs launching a new software product

•           Teams accelerating an existing software platform

 

REASON FOR SALE

 

The founder is now focused full-time on a separate, independent web-based SaaS business.

This platform is being offered strictly as a technology asset sale, giving the next owner a mature technical foundation while retaining complete flexibility to implement their own branding, pricing strategy, and go-to-market approach.

 

FINANCIAL NOTE

 

This is a technology asset sale rather than a revenue-based SaaS acquisition. Development efforts were focused on building a mature production platform, leaving the next owner free to implement their own branding, pricing, marketing, and commercialization strategy.

 

NOT INCLUDED

 

The following assets are not included in the sale:

•           Current brand name and branding

•           Existing logos and visual identity

•           Current trademarks

•           Current domain names and website

•           Seller's separate web-based SaaS business

 

Reasonable technical transition assistance will be provided following the sale to help ensure a smooth hand-off.

Native Collaboration Platform (iOS, Android, Web & Backend)","description_text":"

SUMMARY

Skip 2–4 years of development by acquiring a production-ready native collaboration platform that's been live since 2022. The sale includes native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps, a Java backend, React admin and customer portals, WebRTC voice/video, real-time messaging, and AWS infrastructure. Designed for straightforward white-label customization, it's an ideal foundation for founders and software companies looking to launch or expand a collaboration product without starting from scratch.

HIGHLIGHTS

  • Native iOS (Swift) & Android (Kotlin)

  • Java Backend + React Web Portals

  • Live Since November 2022

  • Complete Source Code Included

  • White-Label Ready

  • Built-In Messaging & WebRTC Voice/Video

  • AWS Production Infrastructure

  • Estimated Replacement Cost: $300K–$500K+

 

OVERVIEW

 

Skip 2–4 years of engineering by acquiring a mature, production-tested collaboration platform that has been live on the Apple App Store and Google Play since November 2022.

The platform has already solved many of the complex engineering challenges involved in building a modern collaboration product, allowing the next owner to focus on branding, customers, and growth instead of core infrastructure.

 

This is NOT an MVP, prototype, or abandoned side project. It has been continuously refined through real-world use and includes the complete source code, production infrastructure, and supporting components needed to operate, customize, or rebrand under your own company.

 

Complete collaboration platform—not just mobile apps. The sale includes native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) applications, a Java backend, React customer and administrative portals, production cloud infrastructure, and the complete source code.

 

Every major system required to operate a modern collaboration platform—including messaging, voice and video, authentication, administration, monetization, and cloud infrastructure—is already built and production-tested.

 

This acquisition is ideal for founders, software companies, agencies, and product teams looking to launch or expand a collaboration product without spending years building core infrastructure from scratch.

 

PRODUCT VALIDATION

 

• Live on the Apple App Store and Google Play since November 2022

• 941 registered users

• 348 new users added during 2026

• 9 five-star App Store reviews

• Recent real-world user engagement demonstrates the platform remains active and production-tested.

 

Rather than existing only as source code, this platform has benefited from years of bug fixes, usability improvements, and production refinement that are difficult to reproduce in a newly built product.

 

WHAT'S INCLUDED

 

The sale includes:

•           Native Swift iOS application

•           Native Kotlin Android application

•           Java backend

•           React customer portal

•           React administrative portal

•           Complete source code for the iOS app, Android app, backend, and web portals

•           AWS deployment configuration

•           Amazon RDS MySQL database

•           Firebase integration

•           QuickBlox messaging

•           WebRTC voice and video infrastructure

•           Push notification infrastructure

•           Production database schema

•           Technical documentation

•           App Store and Google Play listing assets

•           Design assets

•           Reasonable technical transition assistance following the sale

 

INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

 

The sale includes ownership of all original source code developed for the platform, including the iOS application, Android application, Java backend, and React web applications.

 

The platform was developed specifically for this business. No outside developers retain ownership rights.

 

MAJOR FEATURES

 

The platform includes a comprehensive collaboration feature set, including:

•           Real-time group messaging

•           Direct messaging

•           Topic-based conversations

•           Native voice and video calling

•           Shared calendars

•           Event scheduling

•           RSVP management

•           Attendance tracking

•           Photo and file sharing

•           Push notifications

•           Administrative dashboard

•           Customer self-service portal

•           User management

•           Subscription and monetization infrastructure

 

WHITE-LABEL OPPORTUNITY

 

The platform was intentionally designed to support straightforward rebranding and customization.

 

Potential applications include:

•           Church and faith-based software

•           Volunteer management

•           Community organizations

•           HOA communities

•           Sports organizations

•           Schools and PTAs

•           Membership organizations

•           Workforce communication

•           Team collaboration

•           Industry-specific SaaS products

 

TECHNOLOGY

 

Built on a proven production technology stack including:

Swift, Kotlin, Java, React, AWS, Amazon RDS MySQL, Firebase, QuickBlox, WebRTC, Stripe, Apple In-App Purchases, Google Play Billing, and Google AdMob.

 

ENGINEERING REPLACEMENT VALUE

 

Rebuilding a comparable platform from scratch would typically require approximately 2–4 years of engineering effort and an estimated $300,000–$500,000+ investment before reaching a similar level of production maturity.

 

Instead of rebuilding foundational infrastructure, the next owner receives a mature platform that has already been operating in production since 2022, allowing them to focus immediately on customization, customer acquisition, commercialization, and growth.

 

IDEAL BUYER

 

This acquisition is an excellent fit for:

•           SaaS founders seeking an established technical foundation

•           Software companies expanding into collaboration software

•           Development agencies seeking a white-label platform

•           Entrepreneurs launching a new software product

•           Teams accelerating an existing software platform

 

REASON FOR SALE

 

The founder is now focused full-time on a separate, independent web-based SaaS business.

This platform is being offered strictly as a technology asset sale, giving the next owner a mature technical foundation while retaining complete flexibility to implement their own branding, pricing strategy, and go-to-market approach.

 

FINANCIAL NOTE

 

This is a technology asset sale rather than a revenue-based SaaS acquisition. Development efforts were focused on building a mature production platform, leaving the next owner free to implement their own branding, pricing, marketing, and commercialization strategy.

 

NOT INCLUDED

 

The following assets are not included in the sale:

•           Current brand name and branding

•           Existing logos and visual identity

•           Current trademarks

•           Current domain names and website

•           Seller's separate web-based SaaS business

 

Reasonable technical transition assistance will be provided following the sale to help ensure a smooth hand-off.

Overview SnapDocket is an micro-SaaS and automated workflow designed to eliminate manual receipt/docket data entry for small businesses, contractors, and bookkeepers.

SnapDocket leverages Google Document AI (for specialized document extraction) alongside Gemini . Users simply forward photos, PDFs, or scanned receipts to a custom email address, and the system extracts line items, totals, dates, and vendor names with pinpoint precision—logging everything into a structured database or sheet in seconds.

Tech Stack & Architecture

  • OCR & Extraction Engine: Google Document AI (built specifically for receipts/invoices)

  • AI Formatting & Intelligence: Google Gemini API (handles edge cases, line-item categorization, and JSON formatting)

  • Workflow Automation: Make.com (processes incoming emails, triggers Google Cloud APIs, updates spreadsheets/databases)

  • Onboarding with Tallyform and charge with Stripe: allow the system to check for credit before process

  • Why I’m Selling & Growth Opportunities This system was originally developed for internal use to solve a real daily operational headache. The technical architecture is 100% complete, fully tested, and operational.

    Because I operate outside the tech/marketing industry, I don't have the bandwidth or desire to build a dedicated marketing engine for it. However, the system is completely ready for someone with business or sales acumen to monetize in one of two immediate ways:

    1. Turnkey System for Accounting/Bookkeeping Firms: Sell as a branded, white-label setup directly to accounting agencies looking to streamline client document collection.

    2. Usage-Based Third-Party Micro-SaaS: Package it as a pay-per-document or monthly subscription service for trade contractors and small businesses.

Project 1: SceneToSound AI

A user uploads an image or short video, and the backend turns its visual mood, themes, style, and colors into a complete playlist on Spotify, Apple Music, or Tidal.

The developed system includes media analysis, AI playlist ideation, track discovery, streaming-service connections, account management, a token economy, subscriptions, in-app purchases, purchase verification, and auditable entitlement management.

Project 2: VenueAudio OS

A multi-tenant B2B platform for scheduling and controlling music across hotels, restaurants, retail stores, cafés, spas, and other commercial spaces.

It supports multiple properties and audio zones, recurring and one-time schedules, conflict detection, AI-assisted playlist generation, semantic music search, granular user permissions, track ingestion, cloud storage, and a complete web-management interface.

A physical-venue streaming prototype has also been tested. The main remaining task is productionizing the final playback and hardware-delivery layer.

Why this is interesting

Together, the projects cover both consumer music discovery and commercial music management. A buyer could launch either product independently, use the technology inside an existing company, white-label it, or develop a broader system connecting visual inspiration, AI curation, scheduling, and real-world playback.

This is a software and IP asset opportunity rather than an operating business. There is no current revenue or established customer base, so the value lies in the developed code, architecture, integrations, documentation, and time saved compared with building from scratch.

I’m selling because my priorities have shifted, and these projects need an owner with the resources and focus to commercialize them.

I’m open to offers and flexible about deal structure, including:

  • Either project individually

  • Both projects as a bundle

  • Exclusive acquisition

  • Licensing, depending on the proposal

  • Negotiated transition and technical handover support

Qualified buyers can receive a private demonstration and more detailed technical materials. Proprietary implementation details and source access will be reserved for serious discussions under appropriate confidentiality arrangements.
