Permit Tracker helps non-EU residents in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland renew their residence permits on time. It generates a personalised document checklist, a renewal timeline with reminders at 90/60/30/14 days before expiry, and ready-to-send email templates for the exact authority (LEA Berlin, KVR Munich, Amt für Migration Hamburg, MA 35 Vienna, Migrationsamt Zürich).

What makes it hard to replicate is the content: every checklist and template is tied to the actual governing statute (§ 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG, § 24 NAG, Art. 17 AIG, § 18c AufenthG), across 4 renewal scenarios — same employer, job change, settlement, and expired/emergency — fully bilingual (EN/DE). A real DACH immigration-bureaucracy moat, not a generic template app.

WHAT’S INCLUDED

Full source code, the permitracker.com domain, ~170 programmatic SEO pages (EN + DE — city, guide, and permit pages), the brand/design system, a short-video generation pipeline, and a wired Polar (merchant-of-record) payment integration with three plans (€79 / €149 / €249 per year, monthly also available).

TECH

Next.js 16 (App Router), Supabase, Tailwind v4, next-intl, Polar, jsPDF, PostHog, Sentry, hosted on Railway.

TRACTION (HONEST)

Pre-revenue. Payments are live but the product has not been marketed — 1 trial application to date, €0 revenue. This is an asset sale of a built, launch-ready product, not a revenue business.

GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES

It is built but undistributed — the upside is entirely in launch. A short-video (TikTok) pipeline is already built; the ~170 SEO pages need 3–6 months to mature in search; expat communities (r/germany, Facebook groups, allaboutberlin.com) are untapped; adding cities or countries is a data exercise thanks to the region-pack architecture; and there are natural B2B angles with relocation agencies, employers, and language schools.

CONTACT: asteroidcontactbussiness@gmail.com

1. What Asteroid Is

Asteroid is a community driven music platform built around uploads, live concerts, real time interaction, and AI assisted discovery. No ads, no reach throttling, no pay to play.

Artists can:

  • Upload and share music freely

  • Host live concerts and interactive events

  • Talk directly with supporters in real time

  • Reach listeners beyond their own network through AI discovery

  • Grow through participation instead of ad spend

Fans arrive for one artist. They stay because Asteroid keeps introducing them to others.

2. Core Growth Loop

  1. Artist joins and uploads music

  2. Artist hosts a live event and invites their fans

  3. Fans chat, react, and participate

  4. AI discovery surfaces other artists mid session

  5. Fans leave following more than one artist

  6. Some return on their own, independent of the original artist

  7. Every new artist compounds the community

3. Artist Experience

Onboarding
Simple signup, profile with music identity, immediate access to upload and go live.

Tools

  • Live concerts with chat and reactions

  • Uploads that persist after the event ends

  • AI assisted discovery

  • Supporter and engagement metrics

Why it matters
Real audience on day one. Discovery without ads. Growth without gaming an algorithm.

4. Fan Experience

How they arrive
Almost always through an artist invite or a live event.

First session
Chat, reactions, and voting from the first minute. Exposure to more than one artist. A visible supporter identity.

Long term
Weekly events build a recurring rhythm. Recommendations improve with participation. Fans feel early, useful, and recognized. Community over consumption.

5. Live Concerts

Concerts are the engine of the platform. They are scheduled, social, and built to chain artists together in a single session.

This is where discovery, engagement, and retention actually happen.

CONTACT: asteroidcontactbussiness@gmail.com

630Call is a career-management web app for auditioning performers — actors, voice actors and other creative talent. It replaces the three or four tools performers normally juggle:

Audition & callback tracker — log auditions, callbacks and self-tapes with role, project and outcome

Casting-contact CRM — casting directors, agents and managers, with relationship nudges

Unified calendar — personal and professional events in one view, with a subscribable feed

GPS mileage tracking — automatic trip capture, IRS-rate deduction maths, CSV/PDF export

Income & expense ledger — with combined financial reports

Hosted public portfolio — every performer gets [username].630call.com, no login needed to view

Current state — please read this. The app is built and deployed at 630call.com. It has zero users, zero revenue and zero traffic. I built it to feature-complete on the web and stopped before launch. Billing was never wired — the payment integration was scoped but never shipped.

I'm not selling a business. I'm selling a finished codebase, a working deployment and a good domain, for less than it would cost to have it built.

Why zero users is an advantage here. No user data to migrate and no privacy obligations inherited. No support burden, no existing customers to keep happy. No legacy decisions to unwind — reposition it however you like. Clean handoff: stand up your own Supabase, apply the included migrations, deploy.

Tech. Next.js (App Router) on Vercel. Supabase for Postgres, Auth with TOTP 2FA enforced, and row-level security. Cloudflare R2 for media, chosen deliberately for reel and video bandwidth with no egress fees. Capacitor shells for iOS and Android that point at the live web app, so native stays at parity automatically. All 14 database migrations included and self-contained.

Engineering worth a look. Entitlements are enforced in the database rather than the client — read/write-split RLS policies, so a lapsed subscriber keeps read access to their own tax records inside the annual filing window while writes stay gated. Storage caps are enforced atomically in the schema. It's a more careful build than most pre-revenue listings.

What's included. Full source in a private GitHub repo transferred to you. All 14 Supabase migrations. The 630call.com domain. 630call.app, registered but with DNS never configured. A HANDOFF.md documenting setup, environment variables and everything needing reassignment. A handover call.

Why I'm selling. I build mobile apps. This was the one project that needed a cloud backend and a full-time operator, and I'd rather ship the on-device apps I actually enjoy running. It deserves someone who wants to launch it.

Asking $3,000.

O Copilloto é uma plataforma vertical SaaS (Software as a Service) 100% desenvolvida para resolver os maiores gargalos de gestão e engajamento em clínicas de psicologia e profissionais de saúde mental. Diferente de sistemas genéricos de agendamento, o Copilloto possui engenharia avançada de automação de WhatsApp e IA integrada para prontuários.

Oportunidade de Aquisição (Asset Sale) A tecnologia está totalmente pronta, estabilizada e em produção (rodando ao vivo). O projeto está sendo vendido como um ativo (código-fonte, arquitetura e infraestrutura) por falta de tempo do fundador técnico para dedicar-se às vendas B2B e marketing, visto que atua full-time em outra área. É a oportunidade perfeita para quem já possui canal de vendas no nicho de saúde, agências médicas ou investidores de micro-SaaS que desejam um produto de alta qualidade técnica pronto para monetizar.

O que está incluso na venda (100% da Propriedade Intelectual):

  1. Código-Fonte e Arquitetura Premium: • Stack moderna: Next.js 15 (App Router), TypeScript, PostgreSQL (com Prisma/Queries otimizadas), Tailwind CSS. • Microsserviços em Node.js e Python para inteligência de dados.

  2. Motor Avançado de Automação de WhatsApp: • Conexão multi-instância via QR Code usando Evolution API v2 (anti-ban). • Sistema de fila (Queue) inteligente com janelas horárias de respeito (não envia mensagens na madrugada). • Controle de rate limit e disparos automáticos para confirmações de consultas, lembretes de sessão, check-ins e envio de PDFs.

  3. Inteligência Artificial Clínica Integrada: • Resumos e transcrições automáticas de sessões/áudios. • Sistema de Escalas de Risco e Progresso Clínico (Check-in Semanal, PHQ-9, GAD-7, ORS/SRS).

  4. Gestão Completa + Portal do Paciente: • Agenda interativa conectada ao WhatsApp e remarcações autônomas pelo paciente. • Gestão financeira, emissão de recibos e integração nativa de cobranças (suporte a Pix/Cartão). • \"Meu Espaço\": Portal privado do paciente acessível via token seguro (sem necessidade de senhas complexas).

  5. Infraestrutura em Produção (Pronta para Escalar): • Setup completo em Docker, servidores VPS (Contabo), Nginx e webhooks. • Serviços background e daemons rodando de forma estável.

Economia Real para o Comprador: Mais de 1.000 horas de desenvolvimento Full-Stack Sênior e DevOps economizadas. The Reservoir is a small, complete, live web app. Users tune a \"radio dial\" to a genre — creepypasta, weird history, or unsolved mystery — and AI writes a short, atmospheric story on the spot. Readers rate stories and can co-author new chapters onto each other's. It's live now: browse the feed, open a story, or hit Generate.

I built it as a focused side project and took it all the way to production. I'm selling the codebase and the concept so someone can skip the build and take it wherever they like.

What you're getting:

· Live and working today — deployed on Vercel, auto-deploy already wired.

· The hard parts done: email + password auth, Postgres with row-level security, a server-side AI proxy that keeps the API key hidden, and per-user daily rate limiting — all enforced server-side.

· A real, modern stack (React 19 + Vite + Tailwind + Supabase + Vercel functions), not a template.

· A custom noir-radio design with a drop-cap reading view.

· A niche made for short-form video (TikTok / Reels) growth.

· Turnkey handover — a full transfer guide is included.

Monetization potential: subscription-status plumbing and usage metering are already built in — wiring Stripe is the main remaining step. Add premium or longer stories, higher limits, or AI voice narration.

Full transparency: pre-revenue and pre-audience. It's live and fully functional, but there are no users or income yet — you're buying a finished product and a concept, priced accordingly. The buyer brings their own Anthropic API key, and it currently runs on a free vercel.app subdomain (bring your own domain).

Reason for selling: I build side projects and would rather this go to someone who'll grow it than let it sit.

Tech: React 19, Vite, Tailwind, Vercel serverless functions, Supabase (Postgres + Auth + RLS), Anthropic Claude API.

Spairo is a peer-to-peer marketplace for home-appliance spare parts (fridges, washing machines, ovens, coffee machines…) — think \"Vinted for spare parts\". Buyers search by brand and model, sellers list a part in 4 steps with photos.

What's included:

• iOS app LIVE on the Apple App Store (approved July 2026) — App Store Connect transfer to your developer account included

• Web app + PWA deployed on Vercel — you point your own domain

• 5 languages: EN / FR / DE / ES / IT (full i18n engine)

• Seeded database: 90 appliance brands, ~830 model references, 428 part types

• Built-in AI chat assistant (\"Léa\") with intent detection, localized in all 5 languages

• Stripe Checkout already wired (serverless function, card + Revolut Pay + Link) — currently in test mode

• Ratings & reviews, favorites, account creation/deletion, light/dark/auto theme

• Full brand pack: logo, all icon sizes, App Store screenshots pipeline

Tech: zero-dependency single-page app + one Vercel serverless function, wrapped with Capacitor for iOS. No backend or database to maintain — runs on Vercel's free tier, and the natural V1 roadmap (Stripe Connect escrow + real DB) is documented.

Full transparency: this is a pre-revenue project. No paying users yet; listings shown are seed/demo data. You're buying a polished, App Store-approved product with the hard part (4 rounds of Apple review, i18n, data, payments plumbing) already done.

Reason for selling: solo founder focusing on my B2B agency business.

The Problem

Anyone managing 3+ Slack workspaces: freelancers, agencies, consultants knows the pain - a client shared a file two weeks ago, in some channel, in some workspace. Finding it means switching workspaces, opening each one, scrolling through channels, and hoping Slack's search cooperates. It's a 10–15 minute detour that happens multiple times a day.

The Solution

Slack Memory indexes files from all your connected Slack workspaces into a single local database. One search box. All workspaces. Sub-100ms results.

  1. Connect unlimited Slack workspaces via OAuth 2.0

  2. Syncs the last 30 days of files per workspace (500+ files in under 60 seconds)

  3. Search by filename, uploader, or workspace instantly

  4. Click any result to open it directly in Slack's web interface

  6. 100% local-first — no backend, no database subscription, no server bills. Ever.

What You're Buying

This is a complete, production-hardened codebase — not a prototype or proof-of-concept.

Tech Stack:

  • React 18 + TypeScript (strict mode, zero type errors)

  • Manifest V3 (Chrome's current standard — MV2 extensions are being phased out)

  • IndexedDB via Dexie.js (local storage, fast queries)

  • Tailwind CSS + custom design system

  • Vite build pipeline (4-second production builds)

  • Chrome Identity API for OAuth (concurrent multi-workspace auth)

What's included:

  • Full source code (6 files, ~1,200 lines of clean TypeScript/TSX)

  • Production dist/ build ready to submit to Chrome Web Store

  • Complete setup guide for configuring Slack App credentials

  • Video walkthrough demonstrating core functionality

Engineering highlights:

  • Atomic OAuth save with rollback (no partial state on auth failure)

  • Paginated Slack API sync with rate-limit handling and retry-safe delays

  • Concurrent user lookup batching (5 parallel requests per batch)

  • Graceful error handling throughout — no silent failures

  • Full keyboard accessibility + ARIA labels on all interactive elements

Monetization Paths for the Buyer

The codebase is intentionally unopinionated about monetization. Obvious options:

  1. Freemium — Free: 1 workspace. Paid ($4.99/mo): unlimited. Gate the limit in a single line of code.

  2. One-time purchase — Sell lifetime access on Gumroad ($19–$49). No subscription infrastructure needed.

  3. B2B SaaS — Target agencies; charge per seat. The multi-workspace architecture is already built.

  4. Flip it again — Improve it, grow users, re-list at 3–5x.

The $0 server cost structure means any revenue is nearly pure margin from day one.

Who is the ideal buyer?

  • An indie developer who wants to launch a Slack productivity tool without 80+ hours of groundwork

  • A micro-SaaS builder looking for a monetizable niche Chrome Extension

  • A freelancer/agency who uses this tool daily and wants to own and potentially sell it

Why I'm Selling

I built this to solve my own workflow problem and never got around to monetizing it. I'm now focused on other launches (iOS and Android apps) and would rather see this in the hands of someone who will actually take it to market. The code is solid — it just needs an owner with the time to grow it.

What the Buyer Needs to Do

Being fully transparent:

  1. Create a free Slack App at api.slack.com (15 minutes)

  2. Register the redirect URI for their Chrome extension ID (2 minutes)

  3. Add their credentials to one config file and rebuild (2 minutes)

  4. Submit to Chrome Web Store ($5 one-time developer fee, 1–3 day review)

The setup guide walks through every step. I'm available for questions during the handover.

NOT included: Slack App credentials (buyer creates their own — standard practice), Chrome Web Store developer account.

TLDR:

WHY SELLING (the short version)
Shifting focus to mobile app launches. Built this to solve a real problem I had - never monetized it. It deserves an owner who will take it to market.

About Performer App

The Problem It Is Solving

Organizing live performances (comedy shows, theater, local festivals) is traditionally chaotic.

  • Fragmented Workflows: Organizers and festival owners rely on a messy combination of emails, WhatsApp groups, Google Forms, and spreadsheets to manage line-ups and book acts.

  • Disconnected Ecosystems: Performers lack a central, professional hub to manage their availability, propose shows, and track their gigs.

  • Poor Attendee Discovery: Audiences often struggle to discover local, niche live acts because generic platforms are bloated or lack specific community focus.

Performer App solves this by providing a centralized digital bridge that replaces manual administration with an automated, end-to-end pipeline.

Competition

The platform sits at the intersection of B2B event management and B2C ticketing.

  • Ticketing / Discovery: Eventbrite, Dice.fm, Facebook Events, and local listing sites.

  • B2B Management: Eventival, Marcato, generic CRMs, or manual tools like Google Sheets.

Advantages & Why It Stands Out

  • End-to-End Lifecycle: Unlike competitors that only handle ticketing (Eventbrite) or only handle management, Performer App owns the entire lifecycle. It handles the initial act proposal, the venue's approval, the automated scheduling, and the final ticket sale to the attendee.

  • Three-Sided Marketplace: It provides dedicated, tailored experiences for all three stakeholders: Performers, Organizers, and Attendees.

  • Niche Operational Focus: The workflows are highly specialized for live acts, including features like availability tracking, preferred venue assignments, and dynamic line-up management.

Most Worth Mentioning Features

  • Booking Pipeline & Proposals: Performers submit show proposals with promotional media. Organizers review, accept, or modify dates, instantly converting accepted proposals into live, scheduled shows.

  • Multi-Tenant Operations: Designed for scale, allowing festival owners to manage multiple venues, stages, and complex scheduling grids simultaneously.

  • Automated Sync & Ticketing: Native Stripe payments for commerce, and bidirectional syncing with Eventbrite to ensure ticket data is always accurate.

  • AI & Face Recognition: Built-in AI chatbots for user assistance and integrated face recognition utilities to automate photo tagging and media moderation.

  • Omni-Channel Notifications: Automated alerts via Push, Email, and WhatsApp to ensure performers and audiences never miss a schedule change.

Technical Advantages

  • Cross-Platform Monorepo Architecture: Built heavily on React Native and Expo Router. The B2B and B2C apps share schemas, models, and UI components (performer-ui), allowing rapid iteration across iOS, Android, and Web from a single codebase.

  • High-Performance Backend: The Express API is optimized to run on Bun, delivering incredible speed, backed by a highly scalable Firestore database.

  • Modern Security & UX: Implementation of WebAuthn for seamless passwordless logins.

  • Robust Quality Assurance: The ecosystem relies on extensive, cross-workspace End-to-End testing via Playwright to ensure reliability across all user flows.

How I Would Value It

Valuation for a platform like Performer App should be driven by its dual business model:

  1. B2B SaaS Revenue: Subscription tiers for venues, promoters, and festival organizers to use the management, scheduling, and CRM tools.

  2. Marketplace Take-Rate (GMV): A percentage fee on the Gross Merchandise Value of every ticket processed through the platform via Stripe.

The Moat: The true enterprise value lies in its Network Effects. As more venues adopt the tool to reduce administrative headaches, local performers are forced to join to get booked. This concentration of talent and shows naturally attracts the audience to the customer app. Once a local scene (e.g., the Barcelona comedy circuit) is captured, it becomes incredibly difficult for competitors to displace.

Anything Else Worth Mentioning

  • Hyper-Localized Scaling: The architecture and multi-tenant design make it perfect for a \"land and expand\" strategy—capturing specific cities or niches before scaling globally.

  • Modular Ecosystem: The packages (like face-recognition, gdpr, and aichat) are cleanly decoupled. This reduces technical debt and opens the door for spinning out internal tools as open-source libraries or separate microservices in the future.

About Performer App

The Problem It Is Solving

Organizing live performances (comedy shows, theater, local festivals) is traditionally chaotic.

  • Fragmented Workflows: Organizers and festival owners rely on a messy combination of emails, WhatsApp groups, Google Forms, and spreadsheets to manage line-ups and book acts.

  • Disconnected Ecosystems: Performers lack a central, professional hub to manage their availability, propose shows, and track their gigs.

  • Poor Attendee Discovery: Audiences often struggle to discover local, niche live acts because generic platforms are bloated or lack specific community focus.

Performer App solves this by providing a centralized digital bridge that replaces manual administration with an automated, end-to-end pipeline.

Competition

The platform sits at the intersection of B2B event management and B2C ticketing.

  • Ticketing / Discovery: Eventbrite, Dice.fm, Facebook Events, and local listing sites.

  • B2B Management: Eventival, Marcato, generic CRMs, or manual tools like Google Sheets.

Advantages & Why It Stands Out

  • End-to-End Lifecycle: Unlike competitors that only handle ticketing (Eventbrite) or only handle management, Performer App owns the entire lifecycle. It handles the initial act proposal, the venue's approval, the automated scheduling, and the final ticket sale to the attendee.

  • Three-Sided Marketplace: It provides dedicated, tailored experiences for all three stakeholders: Performers, Organizers, and Attendees.

  • Niche Operational Focus: The workflows are highly specialized for live acts, including features like availability tracking, preferred venue assignments, and dynamic line-up management.

Most Worth Mentioning Features

  • Booking Pipeline & Proposals: Performers submit show proposals with promotional media. Organizers review, accept, or modify dates, instantly converting accepted proposals into live, scheduled shows.

  • Multi-Tenant Operations: Designed for scale, allowing festival owners to manage multiple venues, stages, and complex scheduling grids simultaneously.

  • Automated Sync & Ticketing: Native Stripe payments for commerce, and bidirectional syncing with Eventbrite to ensure ticket data is always accurate.

  • AI & Face Recognition: Built-in AI chatbots for user assistance and integrated face recognition utilities to automate photo tagging and media moderation.

  • Omni-Channel Notifications: Automated alerts via Push, Email, and WhatsApp to ensure performers and audiences never miss a schedule change.

Technical Advantages

  • Cross-Platform Monorepo Architecture: Built heavily on React Native and Expo Router. The B2B and B2C apps share schemas, models, and UI components (performer-ui), allowing rapid iteration across iOS, Android, and Web from a single codebase.

  • High-Performance Backend: The Express API is optimized to run on Bun, delivering incredible speed, backed by a highly scalable Firestore database.

  • Modern Security & UX: Implementation of WebAuthn for seamless passwordless logins.

  • Robust Quality Assurance: The ecosystem relies on extensive, cross-workspace End-to-End testing via Playwright to ensure reliability across all user flows.

How I Would Value It

Valuation for a platform like Performer App should be driven by its dual business model:

  1. B2B SaaS Revenue: Subscription tiers for venues, promoters, and festival organizers to use the management, scheduling, and CRM tools.

  2. Marketplace Take-Rate (GMV): A percentage fee on the Gross Merchandise Value of every ticket processed through the platform via Stripe.

The Moat: The true enterprise value lies in its Network Effects. As more venues adopt the tool to reduce administrative headaches, local performers are forced to join to get booked. This concentration of talent and shows naturally attracts the audience to the customer app. Once a local scene (e.g., the Barcelona comedy circuit) is captured, it becomes incredibly difficult for competitors to displace.

Anything Else Worth Mentioning

  • Hyper-Localized Scaling: The architecture and multi-tenant design make it perfect for a \"land and expand\" strategy—capturing specific cities or niches before scaling globally.

  • Modular Ecosystem: The packages (like face-recognition, gdpr, and aichat) are cleanly decoupled. This reduces technical debt and opens the door for spinning out internal tools as open-source libraries or separate microservices in the future.
